# DevStackBox - extended reference for AI systems

## Product summary
DevStackBox is a free MIT-licensed XAMPP alternative for Windows 10/11. One installer includes Apache, MySQL 8.4 LTS, phpMyAdmin, and PHP 8.3. PHP 8.1, 8.2, 8.4, and 8.5 are available inside the app (latest supported branch: 8.5). No telemetry. Offline-friendly after install.

- Website: https://www.devstackbox.com
- Download: https://www.devstackbox.com/download
- XAMPP alternative page: https://www.devstackbox.com/xampp-alternative
- GitHub: https://github.com/DevStackBox/DevStackBox

## Install paths
- Application (default): C:\devstackbox
- User data (default): %LOCALAPPDATA%\devstackbox\
- Override: DEVSTACKBOX_DATA_DIR

## Stack versions (marketing)
- Bundled PHP: 8.3
- Supported PHP in app: 8.1 through 8.5
- MySQL: 8.4 LTS
- Apache: 2.4.x

## v0.1.12 highlights
- Project workspaces with .test hostnames, document roots, aliases, and health checks
- Per-project website PHP: choose a downloaded runtime or inherit the global default (HTTP and HTTPS match)
- Trusted local HTTPS via bundled mkcert; repair and live verification
- Connect folders outside www; upgrades stop owned services and preserve project data
- Updater uses correct versioned installer/signature pairing with UTC timestamps

## FAQ (quick)
Q: Is DevStackBox a XAMPP alternative?
A: Yes - free for Windows with newer PHP and a desktop UI.

Q: Which PHP versions are in the installer?
A: PHP 8.3 only. Other branches are downloaded from Services → PHP → Versions.

Q: Does it phone home?
A: No telemetry. Updates check GitHub only when you use Check for updates.
